Select molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested against target CHEMBL2835 (JAK1) in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2835' and assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return distinct rows sorted by molecule_chembl_id.
